declaration.preface:
Parekh Integrated Services Pvt. Ltd. (PISPL) is committed to upholding and promoting fundamental labour and human rights across all its operations and value chain. The Company recognizes that respect for human dignity, fair working conditions, and ethical labour practices are essential to sustainable business operations.

PISPL aligns its practices with applicable national laws and internationally recognized standards, including principles of fair labour, non-discrimination, and protection of human rights. The Company is committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace where all employees are treated with dignity and respect.
declaration.declaration:
The purpose of this policy is to establish a framework for ensuring that labour and human rights are respected, protected, and promoted across all areas of PISPL’s operations and value chain.

This policy aims to:

Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and regulations

Promote fair, safe, and healthy working conditions

Prevent and address any form of exploitation, discrimination, or abuse

Foster a culture of respect, inclusion, and ethical conduct

Define clear expectations for employees, contractors, and suppliers

The policy further supports the Company’s commitment to responsible business practices and continuous improvement in social performance.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all PISPL operations, including warehouses, transportation, and office locations across all national and international locations. It covers all permanent, temporary, and contract employees across all functions, as well as all internal and external stakeholders associated with the PISPL Group, whether directly or indirectly.

Workplace Health & Safety Management: We commit to establishing a zero-harm workplace culture by embedding safety accountability across all operations.
We will ensure that employees perform their duties in a safe and competent manner in line with workplace health and safety policies and applicable legislation.
We will ensure that no employee engages in unsafe practices or behaviours that may put themselves or others at risk, including misuse of alcohol or substances.
We strive to identify and mitigate workplace hazards proactively through regular risk assessments and preventive controls.
We will ensure availability and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE) through strict enforcement and supervision.
We aim to strengthen emergency preparedness and response systems across all facilities through regular drills and readiness checks.
We will promote a transparent reporting culture for near-misses and unsafe conditions through awareness and non-retaliation practices.
We commit to continuous improvement through incident analysis and timely corrective actions.

We aim to train employees on workplace health and safety hazards that may arise within the premises, along with the necessary preventive and precautionary measures to ensure a safe working environment.
Fair Working Conditions & Employment Sta: We commit to providing safe, fair, dignified, and positive working conditions across all locations.
We commit to providing a secure and positive work environment that enables employees to perform at their highest level.
We strive to maintain ethical workplace practices aligned with integrity, accountability, and professional conduct.
We commit to ensuring that employees have access to safe drinking water, sanitation, and hygienic workplace facilities.
We will ensure that company resources, facilities, and funds are used responsibly and for organizational purposes only.

We aim to train employees on workplace health and safety hazards that may arise within the premises, along with the necessary preventive and precautionary measures, in compliance with applicable occupational health and safety laws and regulatory requirements, including the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (OSHWC) Code, 2020.
We strive to promote work-life balance through effective workforce planning and scheduling practices.
We commit to ensuring equal working conditions for contract and third-party workers across all operations.
Employee Engagement & Grievance Redressa: We commit to fostering an open and transparent communication culture across all levels of the organization.
We will ensure that employees can raise concerns, suggestions, and grievances confidentially without fear of retaliation.
We strive to promote honesty, trust, and integrity in all internal communications and interactions.
We commit to maintaining effective grievance redressal mechanisms that ensure fair and prompt resolution.
We strive to promote honesty, trust, and integrity in all internal communications and interactions.
We commit to maintaining effective grievance redressal mechanisms that ensure fair and timely resolution.
We will ensure respect for freedom of association and employee representation in accordance with applicable laws.
We will promote regular interaction between management and employees through structured forums.
Employee Development & Training: We will ensure that employees understand their roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations clearly.
We aim to encourage employees to achieve mutually agreed performance targets through structured guidance and support.
We will conduct regular performance evaluations linked to individual development plans.
We commit to encouraging internal mobility and leadership development initiatives.
We will support employee upskilling aligned with evolving business and technological requirements.
We will establish succession planning processes for critical organizational roles.
Child Labour Prevention & Compliance: We commit to maintaining zero tolerance for child labor across all operations and business relationships.
We will ensure that no individuals below the legally permitted age are employed in any part of our operations.
We strive to implement robust age verification processes during recruitment and onboarding.
We will ensure robust age verification processes during recruitment and onboarding.
We strive to extend child labor compliance requirements to contractors and suppliers.
We will promote awareness of child labor laws and ethical employment practices among employees and partners.
We commit to taking immediate corrective action in the event of any identified non-compliance.
Modern Slavery & Forced Labour Prohibiti: We will ensure that all employees work out of their own free will and are not subjected to any form of forced or compulsory labor.
We strive to ensure that employment terms are transparent and agreed upon at the time of hiring.
We will ensure that employees are not restricted from leaving employment in accordance with applicable laws and contractual terms.
We commit to enforcing zero tolerance for forced labor and human trafficking across all operations and supply chains.
We will ensure all employment is voluntary and governed by fair and transparent contracts.
We strive to eliminate any form of coercion, retention of personal documents, or unethical employment practices.
We will extend human rights compliance requirements to contractors and suppliers.
We commit to strengthening ethical recruitment practices and due diligence processes.
Diversity, Equity & Equal Opportunity: We commit to maintaining a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, and any form of inappropriate behavior.
We will ensure that all employees are treated with dignity, respect, and courtesy at all times.
We strive to provide equal opportunity in hiring, development, promotion, and compensation based on qualifications, performance, skills, and experience.
We will ensure that no discrimination occurs on the basis of race, gender, religion, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
We strive to ensure that all complaints are handled confidentially and without retaliation.
We commit to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace environment.
We will enforce zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, and inappropriate workplace behavior.
We strive to ensure equal opportunity in hiring, development, promotion, and compensation practices.
We will maintain robust mechanisms for prevention, reporting, and redressal of workplace harassment.
We commit to promoting an inclusive culture through awareness, leadership engagement, and continuous improvement initiatives.

policy.monitoring:
PISPL commits to continuously strengthening its labour and human rights practices across all operations by promoting fair employment, safe working conditions, and equal opportunity. The Company will encourage awareness, training, and employee engagement while integrating learnings from audits, grievances, and feedback to enhance workplace practices and ensure alignment with applicable laws and standards.

All incidents, concerns, or violations related to labour and human rights shall be reported promptly through appropriate channels and addressed in a timely manner. Periodic reports will be shared with management to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement.
policy.reviewMechanism: Reviewed by the Human Resources at annual basis or as required, PISPL will periodically review this policy and its implementation to ensure effectiveness and compliance with legal and regulatory requirements. The Company will assess risks, monitor performance, and update practices based on audit findings, stakeholder feedback, and changes in applicable laws.
